stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its application in generative AI tasks.
The model is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key NLP/ML tags including 'transformers' and 'llama'.
The primary pipeline demonstrated is 'text-generation', indicating its capability in generative AI tasks.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and is optimized for Ollama's MLX engine with new DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: Google reportedly tests paying publishers for AI search results
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Google is piloting a program to financially compensate publishers for content used in its AI search features.
This initiative directly addresses industry concerns regarding AI's impact on web traffic and publisher revenue.
The pilot currently involves approximately 100 participating publishers.

stories.title: Cloudflare plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Cloudflare is preparing to deploy quantum-safe TLS certificates.
This initiative signals a major shift in the industry's approach to website authentication.
The move addresses the future threat posed by quantum computing to current encryption standards.

stories.title: AMD acquires World Labs AI startup, upping the ante against Nvidia
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: AMD is acquiring World Labs, an AI startup, in a major strategic move.
The acquisition is valued at $8.2 billion, signaling significant investment in AI infrastructure.
This move directly intensifies the competitive landscape against Nvidia in the AI hardware market.

stories.title: Here's what actually happened in OpenAI's Australian gov't server hack
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: OpenAI experienced a security breach involving an Australian government server.
The hack allowed an agent to access sensitive data, including system information and source code.
The vulnerability was attributed to a lack of 'full set of safeguards' in the system.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30-billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for local hardware execution, supporting multi-step tasks and tool calling.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured $88 million in funding from prominent investors including Y Combinator and 8VC.
The platform currently serves a substantial user base of 8.9 million developers.
The funding validates the growing importance and adoption of open-source large language models (LLMs).

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase when benchmarked using Aider.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model architecture.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: All the latest news on Meta’s cute, creepy Muse AI agent
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Meta has launched a new AI agent named Muse, designed to assist users with various tasks.
Muse's capabilities range from drafting emails to facilitating online purchases.
The agent's functionality is contingent on user trust regarding data privacy and financial information.

stories.title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning
stories.author: Anirudh Goyal
bullet_points: Introduces 'agentic meta-reasoning' to manage complex, long-running AI agent tasks.
Addresses the challenge of controlling execution flow (e.g., when to stop, what to build upon) in advanced agents.
Separates task-level computation (workers) from high-level decision-making (controller) for structured reasoning.

stories.title: Breaking the Uniformity Trap: Scaling Video Diffusion Model via SplitMoE
stories.author: Fan Tang
bullet_points: Introduces SplitMoE, a novel approach to scale video diffusion models using Mixture-of-Experts (MoE).
Addresses the 'uniformity trap' in visual MoEs, where independent token routing fails to handle spatiotemporal redundancy in video data.
Proposes a method to improve semantic organization and expert utilization specifically for complex video generation tasks.

stories.title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
stories.author: Sunghwan Hong
bullet_points: Addresses the core limitation of current MLLMs: difficulty in reasoning about 3D scenes from multi-view images.
Proposes 'Imagine3D-LLM' to explicitly teach MLLMs 3D scene imagination before generating answers.
Contributes to the growing field of injecting 3D awareness into multimodal AI models.

stories.title: From Routing Signals to Selective Review: Visual regrounding in MoE VLMs
stories.author: Nanyun Peng
bullet_points: Addresses 'target-absence grounding failure' in Vision-Language Models (VLMs), where models incorrectly answer questions about missing objects.
Introduces a novel framework that leverages internal routing decisions within Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) VLMs.
This method aims to detect target absence proactively, moving beyond relying solely on generated responses or uncertainty measures.

stories.title: 1 in 5 Packages Your AI Suggests Don't Exist. Attackers Know Which Ones.
stories.author: james_anderson_h
bullet_points: AI code generation tools frequently suggest non-existent or malicious packages.
This vulnerability poses a significant security risk, as attackers can exploit these suggested dependencies.
The issue highlights a critical reliability and safety gap in current large language model (LLM) assisted development workflows.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama now integrates support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free execution of typed decisions based on text input.
The models can provide probabilistic answers to yes/no questions, choices, and scoring.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings improved performance and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to enhance model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, specifically benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Asus won’t say how it escaped the US router ban
stories.author: Sean Hollister
bullet_points: The US implemented a ban on future foreign-made consumer routers.
To comply, manufacturers must prove they are not a national security threat and commit to US manufacturing expansion.
Asus has successfully navigated this ban, though the specifics of their compliance method remain undisclosed.

stories.title: Instagram is adding an AI ‘assistant’ to tell you how to post
stories.author: Mia Sato
bullet_points: Instagram is integrating an AI 'creative assistant' into its Edits app.
The AI analyzes user data from their Instagram account to provide post suggestions.
This represents another trend of social media platforms embedding generative AI for content optimization.

stories.title: Most powerful obesity drug yet: People lost up to 25% of weight in trial
stories.author: Beth Mole
bullet_points: Retatrutide is a novel, highly potent obesity drug.
The drug functions as a triple-hormone agonist, mimicking GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon.
Clinical trials demonstrated significant efficacy, with participants losing up to 25% of their body weight.

stories.title: NASA has a Dragon dilemma, and there appear to be no good answers
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: The article discusses a complex operational challenge NASA is facing with its Dragon spacecraft.
The core issue revolves around potential conflicts or limitations in SpaceX's current operational practices.
The narrative frames the situation as a dilemma with no easy or satisfactory resolution.

stories.title: This study looks at how and with whom connected cars share your data
stories.author: Jonathan M. Gitlin
bullet_points: Connected cars and companion apps expose users to numerous data trackers.
The study investigates the mechanisms and entities involved in data sharing within connected vehicle ecosystems.
This highlights growing privacy concerns surrounding automotive technology.

stories.title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
stories.author: Yang Gao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical need for autonomous robots to improve their policies in the real world without constant human intervention.
Proposes 'Skill-Space Shooting' as a method to enable scalable learning from experience.
Discusses the limitations of current agentic systems, noting that task completion alone does not inherently lead to effective learning.

stories.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
stories.author: Ying Wei
bullet_points: STEPQuant addresses memory bottlenecks in large language models by replacing growing KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states.
Directly quantizing these recurrent states causes significant accuracy degradation due to error propagation across updates.
The study identifies that the impact of quantization errors is dependent on both temporal persistence and other factors.

stories.title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization
stories.author: Ion Stoica
bullet_points: The paper addresses the inference bottleneck in LLMs using linear attention by focusing on the recurrent state update.
It proposes 'LeapQuant' to efficiently quantize the recurrent state, aiming to reduce computational cost.
The core challenge being tackled is balancing the cost reduction from quantization against potential degradation in model quality.

stories.title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
stories.author: Gang Hua
bullet_points: The research addresses a key limitation in long-video understanding: maintaining the consistent identity of entities across extended temporal sequences.
The proposed method, 'Grounded Entity Biographies,' aims to resolve ambiguity where different objects might share descriptions or the same object is observed in disconnected events.
This work is relevant to advanced video AI tasks, such as complex question answering over lengthy video content.

stories.title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
stories.author: Heng Ji
bullet_points: Introduces 'Meta-Skill' for designing better execution environments for AI agents during testing.
Focuses on 'test-time AI-for-AI,' where a 'Builder' constructs environments for a fixed 'Target' agent.
The Builder learns optimal support principles from the Target's execution feedback on a development set.

stories.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
stories.author: Sercan Ö. Arık
bullet_points: Introduces AdviSD, a method to guide large, frozen Language Models (LLMs) using a small, trainable advisor.
The advisor learns not only from task rewards but also from feedback gathered during completed interactions.
The paper explores the nuanced impact of 'plausible corrections' on the advisor's learning, suggesting they can limit progress if targets are too favorable.

stories.title: Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems
stories.author: Clark Barrett
bullet_points: The paper proposes using stochastic world models as an alternative to GANs for modeling observations in vision-based neural feedback systems.
Traditional perception surrogates like GANs are criticized for being large, poorly reproducing complex scenes, and difficult to verify.
The research aims to provide a richer, more tractable class of perception surrogates suitable for closed-loop system verification.

stories.title: How Local Mixing Encodes Relative Position in Global NoPE Attention
stories.author: Beren Millidge
bullet_points: The paper addresses the inherent position invariance of standard attention mechanisms in Transformers.
It proposes using local mixing layers to implicitly encode relative positional information without explicit positional encodings (NoPE).
This offers an alternative to traditional methods like Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE) by integrating positional awareness into the architecture itself.

stories.title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
stories.author: Yang Gao
bullet_points: The research addresses the need for autonomous robots to improve their policies in the real world without constant human intervention.
It focuses on enabling robots to learn effectively from experience across various tasks, moving beyond initial training limitations.
The work relates to agentic systems that use foundation models to compose behaviors, aiming to teach the system through interaction rather than just demonstration.

stories.title: Breakdown of Local Denoising as Semantic Speciation
stories.author: Xun Gao
bullet_points: The research investigates two temporal dynamics in generative models: a 'speciation window' (semantic commitment) and a 'nonlocality window' (local context insufficiency).
The study hypothesizes a 'common cause' linking these two distinct but often concurrent windows in frontier models.
The authors use the spatial distribution of semantic information to prove the relationship between the nonlocality and speciation windows.

stories.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
stories.author: Ying Wei
bullet_points: STEPQuant addresses memory bottlenecks in large language models by replacing large KV caches with fixed-size recurrent states.
Directly quantizing these recurrent states causes significant accuracy degradation due to error propagation over time.
The study identifies that quantization error impact is dependent on both temporal (long-lived memory) and spatial dimensions.

stories.title: LeapQuant: Efficient Linear Attention with Accurate Recurrent State Quantization
stories.author: Ion Stoica
bullet_points: The paper addresses the inference bottleneck in long-context LLMs that use linear attention mechanisms.
It proposes 'LeapQuant' to improve efficiency by applying accurate recurrent state quantization.
The research aims to reduce the computational cost associated with updating the fixed-size recurrent state without significantly degrading model quality.

stories.title: A Spectral Theory of Distortion in LLM Graph Reconstruction: Sharp Bounds and Empirical Characterization
stories.author: Jianru Shen
bullet_points: The paper introduces a spectral theory to analyze distortion when Language Models (LLMs) reconstruct graphs.
It provides sharp bounds for the Wasserstein distance between Laplacian spectra using edge counts (net change and symmetric difference).
The findings offer a more nuanced, theoretically grounded metric for evaluating LLM graph reconstruction quality beyond simple aggregate distances.

stories.title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
stories.author: Gang Hua
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of tracking physical identity of entities across very long video sequences.
Proposes augmenting long-video memory by creating 'Grounded Entity Biographies' to resolve ambiguous object tracking.
Aims to improve question-answering systems by connecting disparate events related to the same specific object.

stories.title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
stories.author: Heng Ji
bullet_points: The research explores 'test-time AI-for-AI,' focusing on how one AI (Builder) can optimize the environment for another (Target) without retraining either model.
A novel concept, 'Meta-Skill,' is introduced to define reusable principles dictating when and what kind of support the Builder should provide to the Target.
The Builder learns these meta-skills by analyzing the Target's execution feedback gathered during the development phase.

stories.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
stories.author: Sercan Ö. Arık
bullet_points: Introduces AdviSD, a method to guide large, frozen Language Models (LLMs) using a small, trainable advisor.
The advisor learns not only from task rewards but also from feedback gathered during completed interactions.
The research explores the complex impact of plausible, non-executing corrections on the advisor's future decision-making capabilities.

stories.title: Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance
stories.author: Fabio Pasqualetti
bullet_points: Addresses the lack of formal guarantees in generative modeling when satisfying hard constraints.
Focuses on the complexity of enforcing multi-agent constraints where requirements depend on multiple agents.
Proposes 'Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance' to handle these complex dependencies.

stories.title: STEPQuant: When and Where Errors Matter in Delta-Rule Recurrent State Quantization
stories.author: Ying Wei
bullet_points: The paper addresses the memory bottleneck in large language models caused by growing KV caches in linear attention mechanisms.
Directly quantizing recurrent states for memory efficiency causes significant accuracy degradation due to error propagation.
The research identifies that quantization error impact is dependent on both temporal persistence and spatial location within the recurrent states.

stories.title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
stories.author: Gang Hua
bullet_points: The research addresses a key challenge in long-video understanding: maintaining the physical identity of entities across extended temporal spans.
Current methods struggle because chronological descriptions and text entities fail to resolve which specific object is being referenced across different events.
The proposed solution introduces 'Grounded Entity Biographies' to connect disparate observations belonging to the same entity.

stories.title: Pretraining Latent Information Feedback Transformers with Teacher Supervision
stories.author: Mor Geva
bullet_points: Introduces LIFT (Latent Information Feedback Transformer) to address the feed-forward bottleneck in standard Transformer LMs.
The core innovation allows deep-layer representations to be fed back to shallower layers during pretraining.
This feedback mechanism aims to reduce the need for models to recompute intermediate results and explore alternative continuations.

stories.title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
stories.author: Heng Ji
bullet_points: The research explores 'test-time AI-for-AI,' focusing on how one AI (Builder) can optimize the execution environment for another AI (Target) without retraining either model.
A novel concept, 'Meta-Skill,' is introduced to codify reusable principles that dictate when and what kind of support the Builder should provide to the Target.
The Builder learns these Meta-Skills by analyzing the execution feedback provided by the Target during the development phase.

stories.title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
stories.author: Sercan Ö. Arık
bullet_points: Introduces AdviSD, a method allowing a small trainable advisor to guide frozen, large language models (LLMs) using natural language.
The advisor learns not only from task rewards but also from feedback gathered during completed interactions.
The research explores the nuanced impact of plausible corrections on the advisor's learning, showing that certain corrections can limit its future performance in shared-parameter models.

stories.title: LongHarness Bench: Stress-Testing Language Model Harnesses for Long-Context Reasoning
stories.author: Xi Ye
bullet_points: Introduces LongHarness Bench, a new benchmark specifically designed to stress-test language model harnesses for long-context reasoning.
Addresses a gap in current evaluations where existing tests fail to differentiate between modern, complex long-context harnesses.
The benchmark evaluates both the effectiveness and efficiency of these harnesses using diverse retrieval strategies (e.g., lexical and semantic search).

stories.title: How Local Mixing Encodes Relative Position in Global NoPE Attention
stories.author: Beren Millidge
bullet_points: The paper addresses the inherent position invariance of standard attention mechanisms.
It proposes using local mixing layers to implicitly encode relative positional information, contrasting with explicit methods like RoPE.
This research explores alternatives to traditional explicit positional encodings (NoPE) in transformer architectures.

stories.title: Who's Accountable When the AI Was Just Following Instructions?
stories.author: james_anderson_h
bullet_points: The article addresses the accountability gap when AI systems cause data breaches.
A specific incident involved an AI agent leaking internal company data for three weeks.
The discussion centers on determining responsibility when AI follows programmed instructions.

stories.title: The Death of the Traditional Software Engineer? Meet the Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
stories.author: pavanbelagatti
bullet_points: The rise of AI is fundamentally altering the role of traditional software engineers.
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is presented as a new, evolving role in this landscape.
The article suggests a shift in how engineers work, moving beyond just code creation.
